Upgrades the connection to a **WebSocket** relaying Message API's (MAIR-658): one UTF-8 text frame per `MessageRealtimeEvent`, for the conversations the caller is a member of. The full contract (frames, close codes, limits, client behaviour) is Message_API `docs/en/realtime-websocket.md`.

Send a `GET` with `Upgrade: websocket` and `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`; nothing goes in the URL. The session is checked before Message API is called, and the connection is upgraded only once Message API accepted it: a refusal is a real status (`401`, `502`, `503`) with the `ErrorResponse` body. A `GET` without `Upgrade` answers `400`.

The client sends no data: a data frame is dropped, a frame larger than 4 KiB closes with `1009`. The BFF pings every 15 seconds and closes with `1001` a client that answered none for 45 seconds, and after `MESSAGE_WS_MAX_MS` (30 minutes ± 10 % by default). Message API's `4001` (session ended: renew it before reconnecting), `4008` (evicted by a 6th connection: do not reconnect automatically) and `1001` are relayed; any other end of Message API's connection closes with `1013` (reconnect with backoff).

101.description: Switched to the WebSocket protocol; the body documented is the payload of **one** text frame

400.description: Not a WebSocket handshake (no `Upgrade: websocket`, or an invalid `Sec-WebSocket-Key` / version)

401.description: Missing or invalid session, or Message API refused it

429.description: An upstream API rate limit is reached: retry after the Retry-After header (seconds)

502.description: Message API refused the handshake otherwise or did not answer within 10 seconds

503.description: Message API is not configured on the BFF
